_comment: Elysium mainnet (chain 99901, HYPE gas). BloomLaunch v2 behind UUPS proxies: 0.10% platform fee, free launch with a minimum first buy (~$0.05 of HYPE), BLOOM relaunched with 20% to the deployer wallet unlocked (no vesting), platform fees 50% BLOOM buy-and-burn / 50% to the fee wallet. Opening market cap ~$3,000 (44 HYPE virtual) and graduation after ~132 HYPE raised, at HYPE ~$73.60 on 10 Nov 2026. Checked onchain 10 Nov 2026: Uniswap V4 PoolManager and WHYPE from Elysium and Uniswap docs.

bridge._comment: BloomLaunch bridge, 0.1% fee to the fee wallet. BridgeOut (Elysium -> HyperEVM) deploys with the system; BridgeIn (HyperEVM -> Elysium) deploys on HyperEVM with npm run deploy:bridge-in.
